finance.module.name: Finance
finance.module.description: The ledger: every sale, refund, fee and payout as a balanced, sealed posting, with periods a treasurer closes.
finance.settings.periods.length.label: Length of a period
finance.settings.periods.length.help: How long each accounting period runs. Periods follow on from one another, so a change applies from the next period that is made.
finance.settings.year.starts.label: First day of the financial year
finance.settings.year.starts.help: A day and a month, such as 1 August. Periods start on this day of the month. This is Finance's own date and is not the committee year end.
finance.settings.tax.registered.label: Registered for VAT
finance.settings.tax.registered.help: Turn this on once HMRC has registered the theatre for VAT. Prices, invoices and bills then carry tax codes, and VAT goes to its own two ledger accounts. Leave it off if you are not registered.
finance.settings.tax.number.label: VAT registration number
finance.settings.tax.number.help: GB followed by 9 digits, or 12 for a group or branch registration. It is printed on every VAT invoice.
finance.settings.tax.scheme.label: VAT accounting scheme
finance.settings.tax.scheme.help: The scheme HMRC agreed with you. The VAT report counts tax by this scheme.
finance.settings.tax.scheme.options.stan: Standard accounting: VAT is due when you invoice
finance.settings.tax.scheme.options.cash: Cash accounting: VAT is due when you are paid
finance.settings.rules.tax-number-needed: Add the theatre's VAT registration number before you turn on VAT.
finance.abilities.ledger.view.label: See the ledger
finance.abilities.ledger.export.label: Export the ledger as a spreadsheet
finance.abilities.posting.correct.label: Reverse a posting to correct a mistake
finance.abilities.account.manage.label: Rename, recode and add ledger accounts
finance.abilities.period.close.label: Close an accounting period
finance.abilities.period.reopen.label: Reopen a closed accounting period
finance.abilities.settings.manage.label: Change finance settings
